sections.title: Vanishing theorems on abelian varieties
sections.extract: As we mentioned in the introduction, our construction of Tannakian categories will be closely intertwined with a vanishing theorem for perverse sheaves on abelian varieties. In the ﬁrst two chapters of this dissertation which are based on joint work with R. Weissauer [68], we discuss various incarnations of this vanishing theorem and explain how it may be proved in an abstract Tannakian framework.
